dateLabel: c. 1850 BCE (early date) or c. 1550 BCE (late date)
title: Proto-Sinaitic: earliest alphabet
summary: Canaanite-speaking people adapted Egyptian hieroglyphs into a small set of letters, each standing for one sound. This early alphabet is the ancestor of Phoenician, Greek and Latin letters.
why: Ancestor of many modern alphabets, including Greek and Latin.
